title: The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over global function fields
main_claim: Take a global function field k and an absolutely almost simple, simply connected k-group G. Every noncentral normal subgroup N of G(k) equals delta_A^{-1}(W) for some open normal subgroup W of the product of the compact local groups G(k_v), v in A(G), where A(G) is the set of places where G is anisotropic. The paper says this holds in every positive characteristic. After reducing to anisotropic outer type A (SU(D,*)), it proves this by showing V_0 = R for every power subgroup R = S(k)^e, by induction on the degree.
